card.name: Digits inside ISBNs and ZIP codes
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long identifier number, such as an ISBN, a US ZIP code or ZIP+4, or a phone number. It fires on the digit itself, with more digits following.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit inside the hyphenated groups of an ISBN in a reference list.

modes.label: ZIP code digits
modes.description: A digit inside a US ZIP code in an address or trial site listing.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a phone number.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a long code number such as an ISBN, ZIP code or phone number.
